basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed Research Engineer | Enterprise AI in Production | Evals, Agentic Workflows, Data Design
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who lives inside enterprise AI systems in production. At LumApps I embed with GTM teams, surface real failure modes in multi-agent workflows, design golden datasets and LLM-as-judge evals on LangSmith, and run tight experimental loops that took open rates and approved opportunities to 2x. Prior 6 years at Beekeeper covered shipping LLM pipelines and AI features to 10M+ users with instrumentation from day one. Anand Creations is my independent forward-deployed practice. Founder-mode iteration, MBA-trained business framing, and a public writing habit (12+ articles and conference talks) that turns work into reusable research artifacts.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own the eval and data layer for a production multi-agent system: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scorers on LangSmith, regression checks on every prompt change, cost-per-request telemetry. Failure modes surfaced from production get formalized into datasets that target the exact weakness.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying 5+ enterprise silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware source. Freshness layer flags stale facts before they hallucinate downstream.

Run tight experimental loops with SMEs and stakeholders to validate hypotheses and quantify improvements: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M/quarter forecast revenue.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house Python + OpenAI pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Diagnosed failure modes across content types, iterated dataset and prompt design per locale, shipped with quality guardrails.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist: prompt-driven guide that turns new-signup context into personalized, high-touch setup. Instrumented for real-world quality so every regression showed up in the dashboard, not the customer.

Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams: redesigned indexing and ranking (Elastic Search, ClickHouse) driven by measured relevance failures, not intuition. Measurable engagement lift for 10M+ users.

Ran observability and on-call for global production LLM systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse): prompt-level traces, cost dashboards, drift alerts. Built the lightweight tooling that made rapid iteration safe.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Decision-oriented analysis, presented to investment committees.
Advised portfolio founders on eval design, agentic workflow choices, and translating operational issues into structured research problems.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Foundational optimization, search, and fitness-landscape work that underpins how I approach eval and iteration today.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence platform for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals with explainability built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Every signal is a labelled example for future eval.

Ran discovery with real users, built RAG-grounded assistant answering DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions with citations back to the regulation. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction from feedback-driven iteration.
